audits.title: 670 Documentation and Communication of National Emergency Laparotomy Audit (NELA) Mortality and Morbidity Scoring with Patients Prior To Consenting: Are We Following the Best Practice?
audits.standard: NELA guidance on preoperative risk stratification and NELA fifth report recommendations
audits.setting: North Manchester General Hospital, district general hospital

cycle1.result: NELA risk score documented in 26%; NELA score discussion with patient/family documented in 14%.

audits.other_findings: Even when the NELA score was calculated preoperatively, discussion with the patient was usually not documented.
audits.citation: Barghash M, Rehman J, Salimi F, Mansour M. 670 Documentation and Communication of National Emergency Laparotomy Audit (NELA) Mortality and Morbidity Scoring with Patients Prior To Consenting: Are We Following the Best Practice?. British Journal of Surgery. 2021;108(Supplement_6). doi:10.1093/bjs/znab259.086.

audits.title: EP.FRI.454 National Emergency Laparotomy Audit: are we compliant with pre-operative mortality risk documentation?
audits.standard: NELA key performance indicator: pre-operative mortality risk calculated and documented on consent form and in medical record; target ≥ 85%

cycle1.result: 80% (n = 39) had a calculated risk; of 27 (55%) who went to theatre, none had correct documentation as per NELA standards

audits.intervention: Proposed only: NELA pathway document, poster and pre-operative mortality risk sticker
audits.other_findings: Of 7 trainee and consultant questionnaire respondents, 4 rarely or never documented pre-operative mortality risk as per NELA guidance.
audits.citation: Lam M, Ng S. EP.FRI.454 National Emergency Laparotomy Audit: are we compliant with pre-operative mortality risk documentation?. British Journal of Surgery. 2021;108(Supplement_7). doi:10.1093/bjs/znab312.071.

audits.title: EGS P32 Audit for evaluation of using the National Emergency Laparotomy Audit (NELA) as risk assessment calculator for high-risk surgical patients undergoing emergency laparotomy
audits.standard: NELA guidelines for risk assessment and documentation in emergency laparotomy
audits.setting: Single centre, University Hospital Hairmyres, NHS Lanarkshire

cycle1.result: About 21% of CEPOD booking forms had a recorded NELA score; NELA form or risk score missing in up to 97% of files and operation notes.

audits.other_findings: Mortality was 21% for NELA score over 20%; 48% stayed longer than 10 days.
audits.citation: Hobeita W, Mohamed H, Karar K, Di-Rollo D. EGS P32 Audit for evaluation of using the National Emergency Laparotomy Audit (NELA) as risk assessment calculator for high-risk surgical patients undergoing emergency laparotomy. British Journal of Surgery. 2023;110(Supplement_8). doi:10.1093/bjs/znad348.078.

audits.title: EP403 - Departmental Engagement in NELA AUDIT and Royal College Standards of Risk Assessment
audits.standard: NELA and Royal College standards: NELA score documented by ST3+, frailty assessment in patients 65+
audits.setting: Frimley Park Hospital Foundation Trust, emergency laparotomy theatre cases

cycle1.result: NELA score documented 39.6%; documented by ST3+ 24.8%; P-POSSUM documented 61.4%; both NELA and P-POSSUM 32.7%; frailty assessed in 38.6% of patients 65+.

audits.other_findings: Authors propose education and procedural change with re-audit.
audits.citation: Nelson-Sice R, Choo L, Mclachlan G, Kyle E, Burton S, Wilson I. EP403 - Departmental Engagement in NELA AUDIT and Royal College Standards of Risk Assessment. British Journal of Surgery. 2024;111(Supplement_8). doi:10.1093/bjs/znae197.489.

audits.title: EGS SO09 - Documentation Of Mortality While Consenting For Major Emergency Operation In General Surgery : Are We Informing Patients Or Just Impressing NELA? A Three-Cycle Clinical Audit
audits.standard: NCEPOD 2011: risk of mortality explicitly discussed and documented on consent forms and in medical records
audits.setting: West Suffolk Hospital, Bury St Edmunds, emergency general surgery

cycle1.result: Mortality documented in NELA 93%, consent forms 40%, medical notes discussion 35%

audits.intervention: Periodic reminders for surgeons during meetings and posters

cycle2.result: Mortality documented in NELA 90%, consent forms 92%, medical notes 51% (consent improvement p < 0.0001)

audits.other_findings: Three cycles; second cycle (March to May 2022, 38 cases) showed 92% NELA, 71% consent forms and 42% notes.
audits.citation: Isswiasi S, Esawi A, Anwaar M, Lord I. EGS SO09 - Documentation Of Mortality While Consenting For Major Emergency Operation In General Surgery : Are We Informing Patients Or Just Impressing NELA? A Three-Cycle Clinical Audit. British Journal of Surgery. 2024;111(Supplement_9). doi:10.1093/bjs/znae271.099.

audits.title: TTP8.11 Audit of Compliance, Documentation, and Score validity in Emergency Laparotomy Care: An overview of NELA scoring
audits.standard: NELA standards for preoperative risk assessment, risk communication and multidisciplinary input

cycle1.result: NELA score calculated preoperatively in 94.7%; mortality risk discussion documented on 17.86% of consent forms; elderly care involvement in 12.5% of patients aged ≥60; critical care input in 66.07%.

audits.other_findings: NELA score sensitivity 33.33% and specificity 84.31% for mortality at a 10% threshold; overall mortality 5.26%.
audits.citation: Almoshantaf M, Aslam R, Harvey J, Casson D, Sheth H, Othman Y. TTP8.11 Audit of Compliance, Documentation, and Score validity in Emergency Laparotomy Care: An overview of NELA scoring. British Journal of Surgery. 2025;112(Supplement_13). doi:10.1093/bjs/znaf166.317.

audits.title: Emergency laparotomy risk assessment: An audit of South Australian hospitals.
audits.standard: Recommendation for documented pre-operative risk assessment (e.g. NELA, POSSUM, ACS-NSQIP) in emergency laparotomy

cycle1.result: Pre-operative risk assessment recorded for 42 (10%) operations; 30-day mortality 9%.

audits.other_findings: Participation in ANZELA associated with higher risk assessment rates; no mortality difference with or without documented assessment.
audits.citation: Hewitt JN, Milton TJ, Lee OT, Tinnion J, Barbaro A, Foley K, et al.. Emergency laparotomy risk assessment: An audit of South Australian hospitals. Surg Pract Sci. 2023;15:100225. doi:10.1016/j.sipas.2023.100225. PMID: 39844804.
